draft.subject: Adding the rest of the North Group team
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for the update — glad Wrenfield is landing well so far, and sorry the bulk import question took a couple of replies to close out. To confirm what Tariq shared: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, it's worth having one project in place as your team arrives. Want me to walk you through that first project on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
